provenance.prompt: Use the reference image as the first frame. Fixed tripod view: the shelf edges, plant pot and clock stay in exactly the same screen positions and sizes for the whole shot. The fern is already moving in a strong intermittent breeze. All motion is in the flexible fern leaves; the terracotta pot stays planted on the upper shelf. The clock stays below on the lower shelf and its second hand ticks. Keep both entire objects and both shelves inside the frame. Show five seconds of continuous real leaf movement at normal speed. No camera motion, zoom, dolly, reframing, image scaling or cuts. No speech.
